# Duration.TotalMinutes

```m
Duration.TotalMinutes(duration as nullable duration) as nullable number
```

Returns the total minutes spanned by `duration`.

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `duration` | `nullable duration` | no |
